editionContext.scope: The story of Siavash from his birth to his death and what follows at once, to Rostam’s vow of vengeance; the poet’s preface and the story of Kay Khosrow are not part of it.

sources.title: Ganjoor: the story of Siavash, its sections
Ganjoor: بخش ۲ - نخچیر طوس و گیو در مرز توران، یافتن ماه‌روی و ستیز تا سپردن او به کاووس
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۲ - نخچیر طوس و گیو در مرز توران، یافتن ماه‌روی و ستیز تا سپردن او به کاووس

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۳ - زادن سیاوش، پرورشش به دست رستم، بازگشت به کاووس و آغاز دلباختگی سودابه
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۳ - زادن سیاوش، پرورشش به دست رستم، بازگشت به کاووس و آغاز دلباختگی سودابه

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۴ - کام‌جویی سودابه از سیاوش، تهمت ناروا و گذر بی‌گزند او از کوه آتش
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۴ - کام‌جویی سودابه از سیاوش، تهمت ناروا و گذر بی‌گزند او از کوه آتش

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۵ - داوطلب شدن سیاوش برای جنگ افراسیاب، گشودن بلخ و نامهٔ کاووس در نهی از شتاب
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۵ - داوطلب شدن سیاوش برای جنگ افراسیاب، گشودن بلخ و نامهٔ کاووس در نهی از شتاب

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۶ - خواب سهمگین افراسیاب، تعبیر موبدان و فرستادن گرسیوز با پیام آشتی به سیاوش
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۶ - خواب سهمگین افراسیاب، تعبیر موبدان و فرستادن گرسیوز با پیام آشتی به سیاوش

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۷ - آمدن گرسیوز با خواستهٔ آشتی، گروگان و بازگشت افراسیاب، و خشم کاووس و گسیل طوس
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۷ - آمدن گرسیوز با خواستهٔ آشتی، گروگان و بازگشت افراسیاب، و خشم کاووس و گسیل طوس

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۸ - نامهٔ پرخشم کاووس، امتناع سیاوش از پیمان‌شکنی و دعوت افراسیاب به توران
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۸ - نامهٔ پرخشم کاووس، امتناع سیاوش از پیمان‌شکنی و دعوت افراسیاب به توران

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۹ - ورود سیاوش به توران، پذیرایی پیران و افراسیاب، پیوند با جریره و فرنگیس و بنیاد سیاوش‌گرد
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۹ - ورود سیاوش به توران، پذیرایی پیران و افراسیاب، پیوند با جریره و فرنگیس و بنیاد سیاوش‌گرد

sources.title: Ganjoor: بخش ۱۰ - رشک گرسیوز از جاه و هنر سیاوش، بدگویی نزد افراسیاب و فریب سیاوش به زاری دروغین
sources.passageLocator: بخش ۱۰ - رشک گرسیوز از جاه و هنر سیاوش، بدگویی نزد افراسیاب و فریب سیاوش به زاری دروغین

events.label: A woman found at the Turan border
events.summary: Out hunting near the frontier of Turan, Tus and Giv come upon a beautiful young woman in a thicket who says she fled her drunken father. Both claim her, so they take her to Kay Kavus, who hears her noble descent and places her in his women's quarters.

entityAssociations.role: young woman found in the thicket
named by her as a kinsman

events.label: A son is born to Kavus
events.summary: The woman gives birth to a son and the king names him Siavash. The star-readers see trouble in the child's fortune, and Kavus turns to God over it.

events.label: Rostam raises the boy in Zabulistan
events.summary: Rostam asks to bring the child up himself, and Kavus agrees. In Zabulistan Rostam teaches him riding, archery, the hunt, courtly custom and the leading of armies.

events.label: The prince returns to his father
events.summary: Grown up, Siavash asks to see his father, and Rostam escorts him back amid great celebration. Kavus welcomes him, tests him for seven years and then gives him a crown and the land of Kohestan.

entityAssociations.role: king who receives and tests him

events.label: An invitation to the women's quarters
events.summary: Sudabeh, the king's wife, sees Siavash and secretly invites him to the women's quarters; he refuses, so she asks Kavus, who orders the visit. Led by Hirbad, Siavash is embraced at length by Sudabeh and senses that her affection is not innocent.

events.label: A marriage is proposed
events.summary: Sudabeh proposes that Siavash marry one of her daughters, and Kavus asks his son to choose a bride. Siavash asks that Sudabeh be kept out of it, but the king laughs and says her words come from care for him.

entityAssociations.role: king seeking a bride for his son

events.label: Sudabeh reveals her desire
events.summary: On a second visit Sudabeh shows him the young maidens, then offers herself and asks him to swear to protect her after the king. Unwilling to betray his father and wary of her anger, Siavash answers gently and asks only for her daughter.

events.label: Refusal and a cry of outrage
events.summary: At a third meeting she declares a long-held love and threatens him, and he refuses outright. She tears her clothes and face, cries out, and tells Kavus that Siavash laid hands on her.

events.label: The king seeks the truth
events.summary: Kavus questions both and smells Siavash's hands and body, finding no trace of Sudabeh's scent. He judges his son innocent but holds back from punishing Sudabeh, mindful of Hamavaran, her past loyalty, his love and their young children.

events.label: The stillborn twins
events.summary: Sudabeh has a pregnant woman versed in sorcery abort her twins and presents them as the king's own children, lost through Siavash. Astrologers find they are not the king's, the woman denies everything, and Sudabeh says all fear to speak against Rostam's ward.

entityAssociations.role: named by the queen as the prince's protector

events.label: Riding through the fire
events.summary: On a mobed's advice Kavus orders a trial by fire between two mountains of burning wood, and Siavash accepts it. Dressed in white, he rides through the flames and comes out unharmed while the crowd rejoices.

entityAssociations.role: queen who watches from the palace

events.label: A sentence and a pardon
events.summary: Kavus condemns Sudabeh to be hanged, but Siavash asks him to spare her and the king pardons her. In time the king's love for her returns, and she again works in secret against Siavash.

entityAssociations.role: blamed by the queen for sorcery

events.label: Siavash asks to lead the war
events.summary: News comes that Afrasiab is marching on Iran with a hundred thousand riders. Hoping to escape Sudabeh and win renown, Siavash asks to command; Kavus sends Rostam with him, and father and son part in tears.

entityAssociations.role: queen the prince wishes to escape

events.label: Balkh falls; the king urges patience
events.summary: Marching by way of Zabulistan and Herat, Siavash takes Balkh after three days of fighting, and Garsivaz and Barman fall back across the river. Kavus writes back that he should hold his ground and let Afrasiab come to him.

entityAssociations.role: host of the army in Zabulistan
king of Turan who hears the report

events.label: Afrasiab's terrible dream
events.summary: Afrasiab wakes screaming from a dream of blood, defeat and the young son of Kavus striking him down. His mobeds warn that war with Siavash brings ruin either way, so he resolves on peace and sends Garsivaz with rich gifts.

entityAssociations.role: brother sent with the peace offer

events.label: Peace for a hundred hostages
events.summary: Garsivaz brings the gifts to Balkh, and on Rostam's advice Siavash asks for a hundred of Afrasiab's kin as hostages and the Iranian lands he holds. Afrasiab agrees, sends the hostages and withdraws to Gang.

events.label: Kavus rejects the peace
events.summary: Rostam carries Siavash's letter to Kavus, who rages, orders the hostages sent to him for execution and demands war. When Rostam objects, the king blames him and appoints Tus instead, and Rostam leaves in anger.

events.label: A harsh letter and a hard choice
events.summary: Kavus's angry letter orders Siavash to send the hostages and fight, or hand the army to Tus. Unwilling to break his oath or send innocent men to death, Siavash tells Bahram and Zangeh he will seek another land, and they fail to dissuade him.

events.label: An invitation from Afrasiab
events.summary: Zangeh returns the hostages to Afrasiab and asks for passage. On Piran's advice Afrasiab writes inviting Siavash to stay in Turan as a son, and Siavash, after writing to his father, hands the army to Bahram and leaves with three hundred riders.

entityAssociations.role: warrior left in charge of the army
king who receives his son's letter

events.label: A welcome across the river
events.summary: Siavash crosses the Jeyhun and Piran meets him with a great escort; remembering Iran, Siavash weeps, and Piran pledges to protect him like a father. At Gang, Afrasiab comes out on foot to embrace him and gives him a palace.

events.label: Feats at polo, archery and hunt
events.summary: Siavash outshines everyone at polo, strings a bow Garsivaz cannot, hits the mark again and again and cuts a wild ass in two on the hunt. Some Turks murmur, but Afrasiab keeps him constantly at his side.

entityAssociations.role: noble who fails to string the bow

events.label: Marriage to Jarira
events.summary: After a year Piran urges him to take a wife in Turan and offers his eldest daughter, Jarira. Golshahr prepares the bride, and Siavash lives happily with her.

events.label: Marriage to Farangis
events.summary: Piran then proposes Afrasiab's daughter Farangis, and Siavash, accepting he may never see Iran again, agrees in tears. Afrasiab hesitates over a star-reading about an heir of the two lines but yields to Piran, and after the wedding grants Siavash a realm reaching to the sea of China.

entityAssociations.role: Piran's wife who brings the bride

events.label: A city site and dark forebodings
events.summary: Free to choose his seat, Siavash travels with Piran by way of Khotan and builds the mountain stronghold of Gang-dezh. When astrologers call his chosen site unlucky he grieves, and he tells Piran that he foresees misfortune for himself and both lands.

events.label: Siavashgerd rises
events.summary: While Piran collects tribute as far as India, Siavash builds a garden city adorned with paintings of kings and heroes and names it Siavashgerd. Piran visits and praises it to Afrasiab, who sends Garsivaz to see it.

entityAssociations.role: visitor who reports to the king

events.label: Garsivaz visits Siavashgerd
events.summary: Garsivaz arrives as news comes that Jarira has borne Siavash a son, Farud, and the sight of Siavash's power and Farangis's palace fills him with envy. In contests Siavash pierces armour and shields and throws the champions Garuy-ye Zereh and Damur from their saddles.

events.label: Slander at Afrasiab's court
events.summary: Back at court Garsivaz tells Afrasiab that Siavash is in secret contact with Kavus and other kings. Afrasiab is torn and thinks of sending him back to his father; Garsivaz argues against it, keeps up his accusations and is sent to summon Siavash and Farangis.

events.label: False tears
events.summary: Siavash gladly prepares to go, but Garsivaz weeps and warns him that Afrasiab has turned against him, recalling how Afrasiab killed his own brother Aghriras. Siavash believes him and agrees to write instead and let Garsivaz plead for him.

entityAssociations.role: brother of Afrasiab recalled by the envoy

events.label: A letter and a lie
events.summary: Siavash writes that Farangis is ill and he cannot come. Garsivaz hurries to Afrasiab and claims that Siavash scorned him and awaits foreign armies, and Afrasiab sets out with his troops.

entityAssociations.role: prince who writes to the king
wife named as ill in the letter

events.label: A dream of fire and water
events.summary: Siavash wakes from a dream of a river, a mountain of fire and Afrasiab, and scouts report the Turanian army approaching. Farangis begs him to flee; he tells her what he foresees, whispers to his horse Behzad and sets out toward Iran.

events.label: Overtaken on the road
events.summary: Afrasiab's army overtakes him, and Garsivaz points to his armour as proof of hostility. Siavash will not fight, his men are cut down, and he is wounded and bound by Garuy-ye Zereh; Pilsam and Farangis plead for him, and Farangis is locked away.

entityAssociations.role: young noble who pleads for restraint
wife who pleads with her father

events.label: The death of Siavash
events.summary: Dragged on foot out of the city, Siavash prays for a descendant to avenge him and sends a farewell to Piran through Pilsam. Garuy-ye Zereh takes Garsivaz's dagger and beheads him over a golden basin, and a black wind darkens the sky.

entityAssociations.role: noble who hands over the dagger

events.label: Piran saves Farangis
events.summary: Farangis cuts her hair and curses her father, who orders her dragged out and beaten. Pilsam, Lahhak and Farshidvard ride to Piran, who rushes to court, wins her from Afrasiab and takes her to Khotan into Golshahr's care.

entityAssociations.role: Piran's city where she is sheltered

events.label: The news reaches Iran
events.summary: When word of Siavash's killing reaches Kavus he falls from his throne, and the nobles mourn in black and dust. In Zabulistan Rostam faints at the news and Zal tears his face.

events.label: Rostam's reckoning and vow
events.summary: Rostam comes to court, blames Kavus for following Sudabeh, then drags her from her chamber and kills her while the king does not move. He swears before the gathered heroes to avenge Siavash, and the army prepares to march.

entityAssociations.role: named by Rostam as the slayer
